A.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(toInt64(timestamp)), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.compute_target_id'] AS compute_target_id, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body = 'compute_target.offline' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, compute_target_id ORDER BY ts

annotations.description: Open the Runners dashboard (compute_target.offline events) and check the runner host.
